sanskrit_verse: राज्ञा परीक्ष्यं न यथा जायते वर्णसङ्करः तस्माद्राज्ञा विशेषेण त्रयी रक्ष्या तु संकरात्
transliteration: rājñā parīkṣyaṃ na yathā jāyate varṇasaṃkaraḥ tasmād rājñā viśeṣeṇa trayī rakṣyā tu saṃkarāt
sph_interpretive_translation: The king must ensure that varṇa-saṃkara does not arise, for it disrupts the natural order; therefore, he shall especially protect the triple foundation—Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma—by which dharma is upheld.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests in maintaining cosmic alignment through dharmic governance.
Causation follows sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) where neglect leads to disorder.
Capacity-based responsibility assigns the sovereign duty to preserve foundational structures.
Restoration logic requires re-establishment of Vedic harmony when disrupted.
Consciousness alignment necessitates protection of knowledge-triad sustaining societal order.
executable_legal_axioms: IF societal disruption arises FROM varṇa-saṃkara THEN INITIATE restoration OF Ṛg-Yajur-Sāma triad AS primary corrective measure.
IF ruler neglects triadic preservation THEN assign automated remediation TO dharmic institutions UNTIL alignment restored.
WHEN causal inquiry traces disruption TO foundational imbalance THEN prioritize consciousness-realigning protocols OVER punitive action.
IF individual or group exhibits capacity FOR dharmic realignment THEN deploy integration mechanisms INSTEAD OF isolation or penalty.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes a threshold of sovereign responsibility wherein failure to uphold foundational dharmic structures constitutes actionable dereliction. The court must assess whether disruption stems from systemic neglect and mandate restoration of Ṛg-Yajur-Sāma coherence before addressing symptomatic effects.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies varṇa-saṃkara as derivative of foundational misalignment rather than inherent fault. Anupūrvaśaḥ demonstrates how neglect propagates disorder. Proportional responsibility lies with the sovereign's capacity to restore. Non-punitivity is preserved by focusing correction on reintegration within the triadic framework rather than inflicting consequence upon individuals.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sovereign audit to trace disruption to its root in triadic neglect.
Deploy Vedic scholars and seers to reinstate ritual-knowledge protocols.
Realign educational and judicial systems with Ṛg-Yajur-Sāma coherence.
Engage community elders to reaffirm svadharma through consciousness-based guidance.
Establish dharmic councils empowered to oversee realignment without recourse to punitive measures.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law is declared: Dharma prevails through sovereign vigilance, not through punitive force. The triad of Ṛg-Yajur-Sāma sustains reality’s order. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. All else is completion.
